data.summary: The validation stage processed 1,000 rows with a train/test/oot split, detected one issue, and identified a high‑severity finding that the challenger was trained and assessed on the same rows. Additional medium‑severity findings and code review issues were also noted.
reasons: High‑severity finding F-02 indicates data leakage between training and evaluation of the challenger.
Medium‑severity findings and code review issues raise concerns about model fairness and code quality.
